title.en: An Act to Provide a Minimum Salary of thirty Pesos a Month for Temporary Sanitary Inspectors Employed in the Public Health Service of the Municipalities.

text.en:
The minimum salary of a temporary municipal sanitary inspector shall be thirty pesos per month;
Provided, That, for lack of funds, such salary may be lower than thirty pesos.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 22, 1934.
